t: Archive credit card transaction data - Commerce | Dynamics 365 | Microsoft Learn
s: For every credit card authorization, the authentication binary large object (auth blob) is stored in the database. Auth blobs contain data that is related to the authorization. Over time, these auth blobs can grow and take up a significant amount of space in the database. The job that is described in this article lets you archive auth blob data by exporting it to Azure Blob storage and then deleting the data from the database.

s: Archives Card is a modern digital card-based system which provides service users with easy access to participating archives throughout the UK and Ireland. The Archives Card scheme is operated by ARA Commercial, which is a subsidiary of the Archives & Records Association, the leading body for archives in the UK and Ireland.
